items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I picked him up, too. A good reader. That's why I took him.

ctx.x: Did you have more than one band? I mean, would you have had another band? Yes, yes, yes, yes. The little booklet I have, the Southern Railroad, or somebody put this out in a book about 1911 with that picture. So I have a copy of that. I think it's at least 1911, then, or before. Oh, this before 1911? Yeah, before 1911.

Yes. Yes. Before 1911, then. Vizcaro was a fellow, that Mexican band was at West End. A Mexican called Vizcaro. He quit the Mexican band. He had some relation here, and he stayed here. He played a beautiful saxophone. Beautiful. I picked him up, too. A good reader. That's why I took him.
Did you use saxophone very much in your early bands?
